examples.en: All my relatives came to the party.
examples.zh: 我所有的亲戚都来参加聚会了。

examples.en: She has relatives in Canada.

mnemonic.tip: relate(有关联)+ive(人)，和你血缘相关联的人就是亲戚。

examples.en: My cousin is the same age as me.
I have five cousins.

mnemonic.tip: cousin 谐音「咳怎」——过年见到表亲，咳一声「你咋长这么高了」。

examples.en: My aunt lives next door.
Aunt Mary bakes wonderful cakes.
examples.zh: 玛丽姑姑烤的蛋糕很好吃。

mnemonic.tip: aunt 谐音「安特」——阿姨总是安慰你、特别疼你。

examples.en: My uncle is a doctor.
We visited Uncle Tom last week.
examples.zh: 上周我们去看了汤姆叔叔。

mnemonic.tip: uncle 谐音「昂口」——叔叔总是昂着头，张口逗你笑。

examples.en: My grandparents live in the countryside.
I visit my grandparents every summer.
examples.zh: 我每年夏天都去看祖父母。

mnemonic.tip: grand(大的/尊长的)+parent(父母)，父母上头的长辈就是祖父母。

examples.en: Her husband works abroad.
He is a good husband and father.

mnemonic.tip: house(房子)+band(带子)，用心把一个家绑在一起的男人就是丈夫。

examples.en: His wife is a teacher.
They have been husband and wife for ten years.

mnemonic.tip: wife 复数变 wives(f变v)，记住这个特殊变化；妻子是家中的「生活(life)」担当。

examples.en: The young couple bought a new house.
examples.zh: 这对年轻夫妇买了新房。

examples.en: I'll be back in a couple of days.

mnemonic.tip: coup(连接，同 couple/coupling)+le，连在一起的两个就是一对/夫妇。

examples.en: Their marriage is very happy.
The marriage took place in spring.

mnemonic.tip: marry(结婚)+age，结婚这件事和之后的状态就是 marriage。

examples.en: We danced all night at the wedding.
examples.zh: 婚礼上我们跳了一整晚舞。

examples.en: She wore a white dress at her wedding.
examples.zh: 她在婚礼上穿了白色的礼服。

mnemonic.tip: wedding 谐音「喂丁」——婚礼上新人互相「喂」喜糖，人丁兴旺。

examples.en: Our neighbours are very kind.
The neighbour lent us some milk.
examples.zh: 邻居借给我们一些牛奶。

mnemonic.tip: nigh(近，古语)+bour(住户)，住得近的人家就是邻居。

examples.en: Their friendship lasted many years.
examples.zh: 他们的友谊持续了很多年。

examples.en: Friendship is more important than money.

mnemonic.tip: friend(朋友)+ship(状态/关系)，朋友之间的关系就是友谊。

examples.en: They have a close relationship.
A good relationship needs trust.

mnemonic.tip: relation(关联)+ship(状态)，人与人关联的状态就是关系。

examples.en: She dances with her partner.
They are business partners.
examples.zh: 他们是生意上的合伙人。

mnemonic.tip: part(部分)+ner(人)，和你分担一部分的人就是搭档/伴侣。

examples.en: She has a twin sister.
The twins look exactly the same.
examples.zh: 这对双胞胎长得一模一样。

mnemonic.tip: twin 里的 tw 像 two(二)，一次生俩就是双胞胎。

examples.en: They have been married for five years.
Is your sister married?

mnemonic.tip: marry(结婚)+ed，处于结了婚的状态就是 married。

examples.en: He is still single.
I'd like a single room.

mnemonic.tip: sing(单个，同 single的sin)+le，一个人、单独就是 single。

examples.en: Three generations live in this house.
examples.zh: 三代人住在这栋房子里。

examples.en: Young generations love the internet.

mnemonic.tip: gener(产生，同 generate)+ation，一批一同出生长大的人就是一代。

examples.en: Tickets are cheaper for adults.
An adult should look after the children.
examples.zh: 应该有成年人照看孩子。

mnemonic.tip: ad(向)+ult(长大，同 adolescent)，长大成人就是 adult。

examples.en: Teenagers often use social media.
examples.zh: 青少年常常使用社交媒体。

examples.en: As a teenager, she loved music.
examples.zh: 十几岁时她很喜欢音乐。

mnemonic.tip: teen(词尾-teen的13至19)+ager，年龄带 teen 的人就是青少年。

examples.en: She had a happy childhood.
This song reminds me of my childhood.

mnemonic.tip: child(孩子)+hood(时期/状态)，做孩子的那段时期就是童年。

examples.en: We should help elderly people.
An elderly man sat by the door.

mnemonic.tip: elder(年长者)+ly，比 old 更客气地形容上了年纪的人。

examples.en: She looks after her little brother.
Can you look after my cat this weekend?
examples.zh: 这周末你能帮我照看猫吗？

mnemonic.tip: look(看)+after(在……之后)，寸步不离跟在后面看着=照顾。

examples.en: I get on well with my sister.
How are you getting on at school?

mnemonic.tip: 两人能一起「get on」(上同一辆车)不吵架，就是相处融洽。

examples.en: They often argue about money.
Don't argue with your mother.

mnemonic.tip: argue 谐音「啊咕」——两人「啊咕啊咕」争个不停。

examples.en: I trust my best friend.
Trust is the base of friendship.

mnemonic.tip: trust 谐音「踏实」——信任让人心里踏实。

examples.en: My family always supports me.
Thank you for your support.

mnemonic.tip: sup(在下面)+port(拿/搬)，从底下托住你就是支持。

examples.en: He promised to help me.
Always keep your promise.

mnemonic.tip: pro(向前)+mise(送，同 mission的mis)，把话提前送出去=承诺。

examples.en: They invited us to dinner.
examples.zh: 他们邀请我们共进晚餐。

examples.en: She invited ten friends to her party.
examples.zh: 她邀请了十个朋友参加聚会。

mnemonic.tip: in(进入)+vite(生命/邀，同 invitation)，请人进入你的生活场合=邀请。

examples.en: We have guests for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我们有客人来吃饭。

examples.en: The hotel welcomes its guests warmly.

mnemonic.tip: guest 谐音「盖斯特」——来做客的贵斯特(客人)要好好招待。

examples.en: The host welcomed everyone.
They hosted a big party.
examples.zh: 他们举办了一场大型聚会。

mnemonic.tip: host 和 hotel 开头都是 host/hos，招待客人的那位主人就是 host。

examples.en: The family gathers at Christmas.
People gathered in the square.

mnemonic.tip: gather 里有 together(一起)的影子，大家聚到一起就是 gather。

examples.en: We celebrate my birthday every year.
examples.zh: 我们每年都庆祝我的生日。

examples.en: They celebrated their success.
examples.zh: 他们庆祝了他们的成功。

mnemonic.tip: celebrate 谐音「塞了不累」——好日子塞满欢乐，再累也值，一起庆祝。

examples.en: We do homework together.
The whole family eats dinner together.

mnemonic.tip: to+gether(聚集，同 gather)，聚到一处就是一起。

examples.en: She is a close friend of mine.
Our family is very close.

mnemonic.tip: close 本义「靠近」，关系靠得近就是亲密(注意这里读 /kləʊs/)。

examples.en: She cares about her friends.
Take care of yourself.

mnemonic.tip: care 谐音「开呀」——真心关心一个人，巴不得对他敞开心。

examples.en: The sisters share a bedroom.
She shared her sweets with us.

mnemonic.tip: share 谐音「晒儿」——把好东西「晒」出来给大家一份就是分享。

examples.en: Children should respect their parents.
I have great respect for my teacher.

mnemonic.tip: re(再)+spect(看，同 inspect)，值得你一再回头看的人=令你尊重的人。

examples.en: The brothers quarrelled over a toy.
examples.zh: 兄弟俩为一个玩具吵架。

examples.en: They soon made up after the quarrel.
examples.zh: 吵架后他们很快就和好了。

mnemonic.tip: quarrel 谐音「夸肉」——为谁碗里的肉多而吵起来。

examples.en: My parents raised three children.
examples.zh: 我父母养大了三个孩子。

examples.en: Please raise your hand to answer.

mnemonic.tip: raise 本义「举起、使升高」，把孩子一点点「托举」长大就是抚养。

examples.en: My nephew is learning to walk.
She bought a football for her nephew.

mnemonic.tip: nephew 谐音「内小」——家里内部的小男孩→侄子。

examples.en: His niece sang a song at the wedding.
examples.zh: 他侄女在婚礼上唱了首歌。

examples.en: I look after my niece on Saturdays.

mnemonic.tip: niece 与 nice 只差一个字母——可爱(nice)的小侄女。

examples.en: Her stepmother taught her to bake bread.
The stepmother in the story is unkind, but real ones are often lovely.
examples.zh: 故事里的继母不友善，但现实中的常常很好。

mnemonic.tip: step(继)+mother(母亲)→继母；同族 stepfather。

examples.en: His stepfather takes him fishing at weekends.
She gets on well with her stepfather.

mnemonic.tip: step(继)+father(父亲)→继父。

examples.en: The old couple have six grandchildren.
examples.zh: 这对老夫妇有六个孙辈。

examples.en: Grandma tells her grandchildren old stories.
examples.zh: 奶奶给孙辈们讲老故事。

mnemonic.tip: grand(隔代)+child(孩子)→孙辈。

examples.en: Their grandson visits them every Sunday.
Grandpa taught his grandson to play chess.

mnemonic.tip: grand(隔代)+son(儿子)→孙子。

examples.en: Her granddaughter drew her a birthday card.
examples.zh: 孙女给她画了张生日贺卡。

examples.en: The granddaughter helps with the shopping.

mnemonic.tip: grand(隔代)+daughter(女儿)→孙女。

examples.en: The bride wore a long white dress.
Everyone stood up when the bride came in.
examples.zh: 新娘进来时大家都起立了。

mnemonic.tip: bride 新娘、bridegroom 新郎——婚礼的两位主角。

examples.en: The groom was so nervous that he forgot his speech.
The groom thanked all the guests.

mnemonic.tip: bridegroom 的简称——站在 bride 旁边的人。

examples.en: Our ancestors moved here two hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 我们的祖先两百年前搬到这里。

examples.en: The family keeps photos of their ancestors.
examples.zh: 这家人保存着祖先的照片。

mnemonic.tip: an(前)+cest(走)+or(人)→走在前面的人→祖先。

examples.en: She has lived here since birth.
examples.zh: 她从出生起就住在这里。

examples.en: Please write your date of birth on the form.

mnemonic.tip: birthday(生日)= birth(出生)+day(日)。

examples.en: My parents celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary.
examples.zh: 我父母庆祝了结婚二十周年。

examples.en: The school marks its anniversary every May.
examples.zh: 学校每年五月庆祝校庆。

mnemonic.tip: anni(年)+vers(转)+ary→一年转回来的日子→周年。

examples.en: They announced their engagement at dinner.
examples.zh: 他们在晚宴上宣布订婚。

examples.en: The engagement ring belonged to his grandmother.
examples.zh: 订婚戒指是他祖母传下来的。

mnemonic.tip: engage(承诺)+ment→婚前的承诺→订婚。

examples.en: They went to the seaside for their honeymoon.
The couple are on honeymoon in Italy.
examples.zh: 这对新人在意大利度蜜月。

mnemonic.tip: honey(蜜)+moon(月)→像蜜一样甜的一个月→蜜月。

examples.en: After the divorce, the children lived with their mother.
examples.zh: 离婚后孩子们跟母亲生活。

examples.en: Divorce is always hard for a family.
examples.zh: 离婚对家庭来说总是艰难的。

mnemonic.tip: di(分开)+vorce(转)→各自转身→离婚。

examples.en: The couple adopted a baby girl.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇收养了一个女婴。

examples.en: The school adopted a new teaching method.

mnemonic.tip: ad(向)+opt(选择)→选来当家人→收养。

examples.en: My aunt is pregnant with her second child.
examples.zh: 我婶婶怀了第二个孩子。

examples.en: Pregnant women need plenty of rest.

mnemonic.tip: pregnant 的 preg 近 prepare——为新生命做准备。

examples.en: They had an argument about the housework.
Her argument for more reading time was strong.
examples.zh: 她主张增加阅读时间的理由很充分。

mnemonic.tip: argue(争论)+ment→争论这件事。

examples.en: Don’t listen to gossip about your friends.
The neighbours love a bit of gossip.

mnemonic.tip: gossip 谐音「果实啤」——闲话像瓜子啤酒，一聊停不下来。

examples.en: Dad’s sense of humour makes dinner fun.
examples.zh: 爸爸的幽默感让晚餐充满欢乐。

examples.en: British humour can be hard to understand.

mnemonic.tip: humour 音译「幽默」——林语堂的神翻译。

examples.en: Thank you for your kindness to my family.
examples.zh: 谢谢你对我家人的好意。

examples.en: A small kindness can change someone’s day.
examples.zh: 小小的善意能改变一个人的一天。

mnemonic.tip: kind(善良的)+ness→善良这种品质。

examples.en: Teaching a child to read takes patience.
Grandma never loses patience with us.
examples.zh: 奶奶对我们从不失去耐心。

mnemonic.tip: patient(有耐心的)的名词——耐心。

examples.en: Honesty is the most important thing in a friendship.
examples.zh: 诚实是友谊中最重要的。

examples.en: She thanked him for his honesty.

mnemonic.tip: honest(诚实的)+y→诚实这种品质；h 不发音。

examples.en: We share the housework in our family.
Doing housework together can even be fun.
examples.zh: 一起做家务甚至会很有趣。

mnemonic.tip: house(家)+work(活)→家里的活→家务。

examples.en: Taking out the rubbish is my least favourite chore.
examples.zh: 倒垃圾是我最不喜欢的家务活。

examples.en: The children each have a few chores to do.
examples.zh: 孩子们各有几件分内杂务。

mnemonic.tip: chore 谐音「愁儿」——一想到杂活就发愁。

examples.en: Our morning routine starts at half past six.
examples.zh: 我们的晨间日常六点半开始。

examples.en: Babies feel safe with a fixed routine.
examples.zh: 固定的作息让宝宝有安全感。

mnemonic.tip: route(路线)+ine→每天走同一条「路线」→日常惯例。

examples.en: Giving red packets is a Chinese New Year custom.
examples.zh: 发红包是中国新年的习俗。

examples.en: Every country has its own wedding customs.
examples.zh: 每个国家都有自己的婚礼习俗。

mnemonic.tip: custom 习俗、customs 海关、customer 顾客——一家三口都常考。

examples.en: It is a family tradition to make dumplings together.
examples.zh: 一起包饺子是我们家的传统。

examples.en: The town keeps the tradition of the spring fair.
examples.zh: 小镇保留着春季集市的传统。

mnemonic.tip: tra(传)+dit(给)+ion→一代代传下去的东西→传统。

examples.en: The family reunion happens every Spring Festival.
examples.zh: 每年春节都是家庭团聚的日子。

examples.en: We are planning a class reunion for next year.
examples.zh: 我们计划明年办同学聚会。

mnemonic.tip: re(再)+union(联合)→再聚到一起→团聚。

examples.en: His nickname at home is Little Bear.
Friends gave her the nickname Sunny because she smiles a lot.
examples.zh: 因为爱笑，朋友们给她起了「阳光」这个绰号。

mnemonic.tip: nick(轻触)+name(名字)→顺口一叫的名字→昵称。

examples.en: Wang is the most common surname in China.
Please write your surname first on the form.

mnemonic.tip: sur(在上)+name(名)→写在前面/上面的名字→姓。

examples.en: The twins look alike but have different personalities.
examples.zh: 双胞胎长得像，性格却不同。

examples.en: Her warm personality makes everyone comfortable.
examples.zh: 她热情的性格让大家都很自在。

mnemonic.tip: personal(个人的)+ity→个人特有的样子→性格。

examples.en: Helping others builds good character.
examples.zh: 帮助他人能培养好品格。

examples.en: Who is your favourite character in the book?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢书里哪个角色？

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：人的 character 品格，故事里的 character 角色。

examples.en: Don’t judge people by their appearance.
The singer’s appearance on stage excited the fans.
examples.zh: 歌手登台让粉丝们激动不已。

mnemonic.tip: appear(出现)+ance→呈现出来的样子→外貌。

examples.en: The New Year celebration lasted all night.
examples.zh: 新年庆祝活动持续了一整夜。

examples.en: We had a small celebration for Grandpa’s birthday.
examples.zh: 我们为爷爷的生日办了个小庆祝会。

mnemonic.tip: celebrate(庆祝)+ion→庆祝活动。

examples.en: I admire my grandmother for her courage.
We stopped to admire the sunset.

mnemonic.tip: ad(向)+mire(惊叹)→对着人惊叹→钦佩。

examples.en: I really appreciate your help with the move.
She appreciates good music.

mnemonic.tip: ap+preci(价值)+ate→看出价值→欣赏/感激。

examples.en: She forgave her brother for breaking the toy.
examples.zh: 她原谅了弄坏玩具的弟弟。

examples.en: Please forgive me for being late.

mnemonic.tip: for(完全)+give(给)→把不快完全「给」出去→原谅。

examples.en: She hugged her mother at the airport.
The friends hugged and said goodbye.

mnemonic.tip: hug 谐音「哈搁」——哈一声搁进怀里→拥抱。

examples.en: They married in the little village church.
examples.zh: 他们在乡村小教堂结了婚。

examples.en: Will you marry me?

mnemonic.tip: marry 结婚、marriage 婚姻、married 已婚——一家三口。

examples.en: Young children depend on their parents.
Whether we go out depends on the weather.

mnemonic.tip: de(向下)+pend(悬挂)→挂在别人身上→依赖。

examples.en: You can always rely on your family.
The team relies on its captain.

mnemonic.tip: re(反复)+ly(绑)→反复绑在一起→信赖；reliable 同根。

examples.en: This photo album belongs to Grandma.
I feel I belong in this big family.
examples.zh: 我觉得自己属于这个大家庭。

mnemonic.tip: be+long：长(long)期在一起，就是属于彼此。

examples.en: The dog obeys every command.
examples.zh: 这只狗对每个指令都服从。

examples.en: Children should obey the family rules.

mnemonic.tip: obey 谐音「噢呗」——让干啥就「噢呗」一声照做。

examples.en: Grandparents sometimes spoil their grandchildren.
examples.zh: 祖父母有时会宠坏孙辈。

examples.en: The rain spoiled our picnic plan.
examples.zh: 下雨破坏了我们的野餐计划。

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：spoil a child 宠坏孩子，spoil a plan 搞砸计划。

examples.en: She comforted her crying little sister.
A warm meal comforted the tired travellers.
examples.zh: 一顿热饭抚慰了疲惫的旅人。

mnemonic.tip: com(加强)+fort(力量)→给人力量→安慰。

examples.en: The teacher praised her for her honesty.
Parents should praise effort, not just results.
examples.zh: 父母应该表扬努力，而不只是结果。

mnemonic.tip: praise 与 prize(奖)同源——值得奖的就该夸。

examples.en: Treat others as you want to be treated.
examples.zh: 想被怎样对待，就怎样待人。

examples.en: Dad treated us to ice cream after the game.
examples.zh: 比赛后爸爸请我们吃了冰激凌。

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：treat sb well 好好待人，my treat 我请客。

examples.en: The twins hate being separated.
A river separates the two villages.
examples.zh: 一条河把两个村庄分开。

mnemonic.tip: se(分)+par(准备)+ate→各自分开→分离。

examples.en: My uncle is generous with his time and money.
examples.zh: 我叔叔出钱出力都很大方。

examples.en: It was generous of her to share the prize.
examples.zh: 她把奖品分给大家，真慷慨。

mnemonic.tip: gener(出身好)+ous→出手大方的→慷慨的。

examples.en: He is too mean to buy his friends a drink.
examples.zh: 他小气得不肯请朋友喝饮料。

examples.en: Don’t be mean to your little brother.

mnemonic.tip: mean 作动词是「意思」，作形容词是「小气/刻薄」——考试爱考。

examples.en: Be honest and tell me what happened.
examples.zh: 诚实点，告诉我发生了什么。

examples.en: An honest answer is better than a nice lie.
examples.zh: 诚实的回答胜过好听的谎话。

mnemonic.tip: honest 的 h 不发音——an honest boy 用 an。

examples.en: It is rude to talk with your mouth full.
examples.zh: 嚼着东西说话很不礼貌。

examples.en: The rude customer shouted at the waiter.
examples.zh: 那个粗鲁的顾客朝服务员大喊。

mnemonic.tip: rude 谐音「鲁的」——粗鲁的「鲁」。

examples.en: Our dad is easy-going and rarely gets angry.
examples.zh: 我们爸爸很随和，很少生气。

examples.en: She is easy-going and makes friends quickly.

mnemonic.tip: easy(轻松)+going(处世)→处世轻松的→随和的。

examples.en: She is sociable and loves parties.
Dogs are sociable animals.

mnemonic.tip: soci(同伴)+able→喜欢找同伴的→好交际的。

examples.en: It is selfish to keep all the sweets for yourself.
examples.zh: 把糖果全留给自己太自私了。

examples.en: A selfish player never passes the ball.

mnemonic.tip: self(自己)+ish→只想着自己的→自私的。

examples.en: She is a caring sister who always listens.
examples.zh: 她是个体贴的姐姐，总是耐心倾听。

examples.en: Nurses need to be caring and patient.
examples.zh: 护士需要有爱心和耐心。

mnemonic.tip: care(关心)+ing→充满关心的→体贴的。

examples.en: A loyal friend stays with you in hard times.
examples.zh: 忠诚的朋友在困难时不离不弃。

examples.en: The dog remained loyal to its owner.

mnemonic.tip: loyal 谐音「劳友」——同劳共苦的朋友最忠诚。

examples.en: She grew up in a loving home.
examples.zh: 她在充满爱的家庭长大。

examples.en: He is a loving father to his three children.
examples.zh: 他是三个孩子慈爱的父亲。

mnemonic.tip: love(爱)+ing→带着爱的。

examples.en: His humorous stories make the whole family laugh.
examples.zh: 他幽默的故事逗得全家大笑。

examples.en: She gave a humorous speech at the wedding.
examples.zh: 她在婚礼上做了幽默的致辞。

mnemonic.tip: humour(幽默)+ous→有幽默感的。

examples.en: She is very mature for a twelve-year-old.
examples.zh: 作为十二岁的孩子，她非常成熟。

examples.en: Talking calmly is the mature way to solve problems.
examples.zh: 心平气和地沟通才是成熟的解决方式。

mnemonic.tip: mature 像水果熟透——人处事稳重也叫「熟」。

examples.en: A typical Saturday for us starts with pancakes.
examples.zh: 我们典型的周六从薄饼早餐开始。

examples.en: It is typical of him to help without being asked.
examples.zh: 不用开口他就来帮忙，他一贯如此。

mnemonic.tip: type(类型)+ical→符合该类型的→典型的。

examples.en: My sister and I have similar tastes in music.
examples.zh: 我和姐姐音乐品味相似。

examples.en: The two houses look very similar.
examples.zh: 这两栋房子看起来很像。

mnemonic.tip: simil(相同)+ar→差不多的→相似的。

examples.en: A middle-aged couple moved in next door.
examples.zh: 一对中年夫妇搬到了隔壁。

examples.en: Middle-aged people often care for both children and parents.
examples.zh: 中年人常常上有老下有小。

mnemonic.tip: middle(中间)+aged(年纪)→年纪居中的→中年的。

examples.en: Senior citizens travel free on the buses.
She is a senior nurse at the hospital.

mnemonic.tip: senior 老资格，junior 小字辈——公司学校都在用。

examples.en: The junior team plays on Saturday mornings.
He is junior to me by two years.

mnemonic.tip: junior 与 June 无关——记 j 小写像个小孩子。

examples.en: Most households in the town have a pet.
examples.zh: 镇上大多数家庭都养宠物。

examples.en: Running a household takes teamwork.
examples.zh: 操持一个家需要全家配合。

mnemonic.tip: house(房子)+hold(持有)→同住一屋的人→家庭。

examples.en: The wedding ceremony was short and sweet.
The school holds a graduation ceremony in June.
examples.zh: 学校六月举行毕业典礼。

mnemonic.tip: ceremony 谐音「晒热闹呢」——典礼就是热热闹闹的场面。

examples.en: Good manners cost nothing.
It is bad manners to point at people.

mnemonic.tip: manner 方式，manners 礼貌——加 s 意思变，考试常考。
